issue: सरजीवन भाण को तुमने कर डारा — who Bhāṇ is was not found (the Rāmdev Chālīsā's revivals are a merchant, Sugnā's son and a Bakhśī's son); भाण may be a name or stand for भाणेज (sister's son).
our reading: Bhāṇ, a name: you brought Bhāṇ back to life
alternatives: you brought (your) nephew back to life
